description: Three groups of fixed seeds, one seed per Reading & Use of English part in each. Run one group a day with --group: a whole group is about one pass of the free quota per model.
why_fixed: plan_task picks a random topic and testing focus when none is given. That is right for a learner and wrong for an evaluation: comparing two models on two different briefs measures the briefs. Pinning both is what makes a model sweep a comparison rather than a coincidence. Every focus is copied verbatim from PART_SPECS.
